AI Overview
Dashmetry is now officially known as Challenge Rush (challengerush.com). 
Dashmetry
What is Dashmetry?
Type: Fast-paced, music-synced rhythm platformer inspired by Geometry Dash. 
Gameplay: You control an automatic-moving geometric cube (and other forms like ships or balls) through obstacle-filled levels matching electronic soundtracks. 
Controls: Left Mouse Click, Spacebar, or Up Arrow to jump, fly, and navigate hazards. 
Modes:
Normal / Classic Mode: Complete full levels from start to finish.
Practice Mode: Use custom checkpoints to learn hard sections.
Endless Mode: Survive as long as possible to set high scores.
Race Mode: Compete to reach the finish line. 
Level Editor: A built-in map creator allows you to design custom stages or play community-created levels. 
You can check out the continuation of the game on Challenge Rush.
